[[File:ZerbaCherdak-Scoundrels.png|thumb|right|200px|A Balosar with antennapalps]]
'''Antennapalps,''' also spelled '''antenepalps,'''<ref name="Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> were the retractable antennae of the [[Balosar (species)/Legends|Balosar]]. When extended, they provided a finely tuned sensitivity to sound, extending into the subsonic range. They could also sense surges in emotion and detect danger.<ref name="uaa">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> A Balosar could pass for a baseline [[Human/Legends|Human]] with his or her antennapalps retracted.<ref name="uaa" />
